question: what year was the transformer architecture introduced
chunks: Recurrent neural networks read a sentence one word at a time and carry the past in a hidden state.
BERT, released by Google in 2018, is an encoder-only model pretrained by predicting masked words.
The transformer architecture was introduced in the paper Attention Is All You Need, published in 2017.
Attention lets each token weigh every earlier token when it builds its own representation.
GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer.
